name: fb-watch
description: Check a Facebook wall for authored posts that have no teaser yet and draft the teasers for short-form channels. Runs as a daily routine or on demand, and stays draft-first. Triggers: "/fb-watch", "check facebook for un-teased posts", "catch up on teasers".
